title: YUB-NUB 1979: The Canopy Launchport
description: The Ewoks have joined Classic Space! A blue-and-grey Logwing Explorer with a yellow cockpit, timber engine pods and classic emblems docks beside a thatched mission-control hut. Suited Ewoks prepare the expedition beneath two ancient trees. A bridge, radar balcony, access stairs, creek ford and little exploration rover connect the forest village into one playable launchport.
